newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: PT, Telebras to present joint venture.
newsitem.headline: PT, Telebras to present joint venture.

text.p: Portugal Telecom and Brazilian telecommunications firm Telebras will present details of their Alianca Atlantica joint venture on Monday, PT said.
Brazilian Communications Minister Sergio Motta will attend the presentation starting at 1600 GMT in Lisbon.
During his visit to Portugal, he is expected to sign a contract for the laying of a cable under the Atlantic linking Brazil with its former colonial master.
At the presentation, the presidents of Portugal Telecom and Telebras are likely to discuss the possibility of Telebras taking a stake in PT, a government source said.
PT recently established a series of agreements with international partners, including MCI, British Telecom and Telefonica.
